panels.title: Data age (seconds since last update) / Alerts

panels.description: Seconds since the last row of each source (SHS1/SHS2/D5 = Hall probes, Log1/Log2 = GL840 loggers, Flow = inlet mass flow). Orange > 60 s, red > 5 min or no data for a day ("stopped"). CAEN / MPPC show the oldest of their crates / controllers (caenhv1-3; raspi1, raspi2, BHT_BLCVth, T2_SCH_BH2). Trigger is written on change and hourly, so it turns orange only after 1.5 h.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM acc WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Acc",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM pps WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "PPS",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM magnet WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Magnet",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM cryomag WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "SHS PS",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM field WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND name = 'shs1')) AS "SHS1",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM field WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND name = 'shs2')) AS "SHS2",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM field WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND name = 'd5')) AS "D5",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM ess WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "ESS",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM target WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Target",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM slit WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Slit",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM omniace WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Omniace",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM gl840 WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND ip_address LIKE 'logger1.%')) AS "Log1",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM gl840 WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND ip_address LIKE 'logger2.%')) AS "Log2",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM massflow WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND hostname = '192.168.20.14')) AS "Flow",
  CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM caenhv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND ip_address = 'caenhv1'))) IS NULL OR (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM caenhv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND ip_address = 'caenhv2'))) IS NULL OR (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM caenhv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND ip_address = 'caenhv3'))) IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM caenhv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND ip_address = 'caenhv1')), EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM caenhv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND ip_address = 'caenhv2')), EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM caenhv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND ip_address = 'caenhv3'))) END AS "CAEN",
  CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM mppchv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND controller = 'raspi1'))) IS NULL OR (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM mppchv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND controller = 'raspi2'))) IS NULL OR (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM mppchv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND controller = 'BHT_BLCVth'))) IS NULL OR (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM mppchv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND controller = 'T2_SCH_BH2'))) IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM mppchv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND controller = 'raspi1')), EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM mppchv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND controller = 'raspi2')), EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM mppchv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND controller = 'BHT_BLCVth')), EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM mppchv WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND controller = 'T2_SCH_BH2'))) END AS "MPPC",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM trigger WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Trigger"

panels.description: Set / monitor current. Dev = (|Mon| - Set) / Set, shown when Set > 1 A. Orange beyond ±1 %, red beyond ±5 %.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.name AS "Magnet",
  (l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cset')::float AS "Set",
  abs((l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cmon')::float) AS "Mon",
  l.magnet_data->m.key->>'pol' AS "Pol",
  CASE WHEN abs((l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cset')::float) > 1
       THEN 100 * (abs((l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cmon')::float) - (l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cset')::float)
                / (l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cset')::float END AS "Dev"
FROM (SELECT magnet_data FROM magnet ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) l,
     (VALUES ('BSM1', 'BSM1', 0), ('K1.8 D1', 'AK18D1', 1), ('CM1', 'K18CM1', 2), ('CM2', 'K18CM2', 3), ('K1.8BR D5', 'K18BRD5', 4)) AS m(name, key, ord)
ORDER BY m.ord

panels.title: Target alarms

panels.description: CAEN: channels with OverCurrent / OverVoltage / UnderVoltage / trip / MaxV / disabled / unplugged ... MPPC: ports with overcurrent protection or current out of spec.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ip_address, board_slot, channel) channel_status FROM caenhv
     WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '2 minutes' ORDER BY ip_address, board_slot, channel, timestamp DESC) c
   WHERE channel_status::int & 61432 > 0) AS "CAEN",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (controller, port) overcurrent, current_out_of_spec FROM mppchv
     WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '2 minutes' ORDER BY controller, port, timestamp DESC) m
   WHERE overcurrent OR current_out_of_spec) AS "MPPC"

panels.title: Flow mon

panels.description: Latest IMon of caenhv3 GEM + Cathode (same as imon_total on HypTPC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT imon FROM caenhv WHERE ip_address = 'caenhv3' AND board_slot = 2 AND channel_name = 'Cathode'
          AND timestamp > now() - interval '2 minutes' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
     + (SELECT imon FROM caenhv WHERE ip_address = 'caenhv3' AND board_slot = 0 AND channel_name = 'GEM'
          AND timestamp > now() - interval '2 minutes' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: I GEM + Cathode

panels.description: Number of MPOD channels (mpod2) that are ON with Imon ≥ 1 A, from the last 2 min. Normal: 31. Green only at 31.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (channel) status, imon FROM mpod WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '2 minutes' AND channel <> 'Mainframe' ORDER BY channel, timestamp DESC) s WHERE status = 'ON' AND imon >= 1

panels.description: Number of recorded sparks in the last 4 h / 1 day. Red above the reference rate of 6 per hour (> 24 in 4 h, > 144 in 1 day).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '4 hours') AS "4 h", count(*) AS "1 d"
FROM spark WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day'
